listings.caption: This `SelfAttention_v1` module defines trainable query, key, and value weight matrices, projects the input into queries, keys, and values, computes scaled softmax attention weights from `queries @ keys.T`, and returns context vectors as `attn_weights @ values`.
listings.code:
import torch.nn as nn

class SelfAttention_v1(nn.Module):

    def __init__(self, d_in, d_out):
        super().__init__()
        self.W_query = nn.Parameter(torch.rand(d_in, d_out))
        self.W_key   = nn.Parameter(torch.rand(d_in, d_out))
        self.W_value = nn.Parameter(torch.rand(d_in, d_out))

    def forward(self, x):
        keys = x @ self.W_key
        queries = x @ self.W_query
        values = x @ self.W_value
        
        attn_scores = queries @ keys.T # omega
        attn_weights = torch.softmax(
            attn_scores / keys.shape[-1]**0.5, dim=-1
        )

        context_vec = attn_weights @ values
        return context_vec

torch.manual_seed(123)
sa_v1 = SelfAttention_v1(d_in, d_out)
print(sa_v1(inputs))

The caption accurately describes these steps.
